_doc: Stand-ins for design track ids that have no rendered track yet (docs/AUDIO.md §4.4): {"wanted_id": "shipped_id"}, '*' globs allowed. The game uses a stand-in only when the real track is missing from the manifest; stems the stand-in lacks are ignored. Round 2: every design id is composed and shipped, so the map is empty (the 'Roll Call' demo is a palette audition and is no longer shipped).
